program:
alphabet marker a b

is_bos = bos
is_marker = symbol marker
is_a = symbol a
is_b = symbol b
h1_1 = rightmost(!is_bos@j & is_marker@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j, !is_bos@j & is_marker@j & !is_b@j | !is_bos@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j)
h2_1 = rightmost(!is_a@i & !is_bos@j & !is_b@j | !is_b@i & h1_1@i & !is_bos@j & !is_a@j, !is_bos@j & is_marker@j & !is_a@j & !is_b@j)
accept = h1_1 & h2_1 | !is_marker & is_a & !is_b & h1_1 & h2_1

output accept
